headlines.headline: LEBRON JAMES SIGNS WITH 76ERS ON A 2-YEAR, $8M DEAL, CALLING IT HIS 'LAST DECISION'
headlines.detail: LeBron James, 41, is leaving the Lakers to join Joel Embiid in Philadelphia on a below-market two-year, $8 million contract with a player option. The move reshapes the East's power balance for 2026-27, with ripple effects for contenders like Detroit.

headlines.headline: FALCONS MAKE BIJAN ROBINSON THE NFL'S HIGHEST-PAID RUNNING BACK WITH A $66.75M EXTENSION
headlines.detail: Atlanta signed Bijan Robinson to a three-year, $66.75 million extension, briefly resetting the running back market days after Jonathan Taylor and Jahmyr Gibbs got paid. Preseason games begin in earnest next week.

headlines.headline: OLE MISS SUES TWO FORMER PLAYERS WHO TRANSFERRED TO LSU OVER ALLEGED NIL DEAL BREACHES
headlines.detail: Ole Miss filed suit against two ex-players now at LSU, alleging they failed to honor financial agreements before transferring, one of the first major NIL-contract lawsuits of its kind. The season kicks off Aug. 29.

headlines.headline: A BLANKET ELIGIBILITY WAIVER EMERGES AS THE NCAA'S ONLY PRACTICAL FIX FOR 2026-27 ROSTERS
headlines.detail: With more players regaining eligibility through the courts, administrators now see a blanket waiver as the only workable solution to keep rosters from being upended mid-season. Season openers are just 100 days out.
